# Brain maps

Parcel results drawn on the fsaverage5 inflated surface (sulcal depth in grey), using the
same Schaefer-400 parcels and ENIGMA annotations as the analysis; rendered by
`scripts/05_brain_figures.py` from values exported by `scripts/04_export_maps.R`. The
ENIGMA `fsa5_*.gii` surface is the pial surface (identical to nilearn's fsaverage5 pial).

```{r brain-figs, echo = FALSE, out.width = "100%"}
fig <- function(f) knitr::include_graphics(file.path("figures", f))
```

**The atlas as used.** Schaefer-400, 7 networks, CBIG colours; and the volumetric atlas
after nearest-neighbour resampling to the ICBM152 2009c grid of the atrophy maps.

```{r brain-atlas, echo = FALSE, out.width = "100%"}
fig("brain_atlas_schaefer400.png"); fig("brain_atlas_volume.png")
```

**Atrophy.** Colour scale set per syndrome because the FTD-variant maps are on a smaller
scale. Below: the same parcel values painted back into the atlas volume.

```{r brain-atrophy, echo = FALSE, out.width = "100%"}
fig("brain_atrophy_all.png"); fig("brain_atrophy_volume.png")
```

**Epicentres.** Epicentre score (mean rank of atrophy and SC-neighbour atrophy) and the
top-10 parcels per syndrome (tables in "D. Epicentres").

```{r brain-epicentres, echo = FALSE, out.width = "100%"}
fig("brain_epicentres.png"); fig("brain_epicentres_top10.png")
```

**Reconstruction from other regions.** Observed atrophy, its prediction from SC
neighbours, FC neighbours and the distance kernel, and what is left after distance (and
after distance + FC). In bvFTD the residual after distance still has frontal-insular
structure that FC partly absorbs; in AD the distance prediction already captures most of
the temporal–parietal pattern.

```{r brain-models, echo = FALSE, out.width = "100%"}
fig("brain_models_AD.png"); fig("brain_models_bvFTD.png"); fig("brain_models_svPPA.png"); fig("brain_models_nfvPPA.png")
```

**Eigenmode reconstructions (K = 20)** and the first geometric eigenmodes themselves.

```{r brain-eigen, echo = FALSE, out.width = "100%"}
fig("brain_eigen_recon_AD_bvFTD.png"); fig("brain_eigen_recon_svPPA_nfvPPA.png"); fig("brain_geometric_modes.png")
```
